# [Baseline] - WIN - U - File Sharing Restrictions

Prevents a user from sharing files from their own profile with other users or the network via 'Share' in File Explorer.

| | |
|---|---|
| Platform | Windows |
| Scope | User (U) — assign to user groups |
| Type | Settings Catalog |
| Assignment | — |
| Source | CIS v4 Windows 11 L1 — IntuneAdmin CISv4 profile 'Prevent users from sharing files within their profile (User)', instance adopted unchanged |
| File | [`Baseline_WIN_U_File_Sharing_Restrictions.json`](Baseline_WIN_U_File_Sharing_Restrictions.json) |

> Does not affect any existing share created by an administrator, only the user's own sharing menu.
